units.source_text: 他是不是打算买了那所房子，每天都到现在这家店铺来上班呢？

en.t: Was he planning to buy that house and commute every day to work at this shop where he was now?

units.source_text: 和东京的银座、日本桥一样，在中京的批发商街有许多老板另外购置房子，然后到店里上班。

en.t: As in Tokyo's Ginza and Nihonbashi, many shop owners in Chukyo's wholesale district bought separate houses and then commuted to their shops.

units.source_text: 若是这样，那还好，说明丸太的生意虽已日趋萧条，但手头还是宽裕，可以另外购置一所房子。

en.t: If that was the case, it was still all right; it meant that although Maruta's business had been steadily declining, he still had enough money on hand to buy another house.
